name.name: name
name.description: Specifies the name of the Key Vault

resource_group_name.name: resource_group_name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group in which to create the Key Vault

location.name: location
location.description: Specifies the supported Azure location where the resource exists

tenant_id.name: tenant_id
tenant_id.description: The Azure Active Directory tenant ID that should be used for authenticating requests to the key vault

sku_name.name: sku_name
sku_name.description: The Name of the SKU used for this Key Vault

enabled_for_deployment.name: enabled_for_deployment
enabled_for_deployment.description: Boolean flag to specify whether Azure Virtual Machines are permitted to retrieve certificates stored as secrets from the key vault

enabled_for_disk_encryption.name: enabled_for_disk_encryption
enabled_for_disk_encryption.description: Boolean flag to specify whether Azure Disk Encryption is permitted to retrieve secrets from the vault and unwrap keys

enabled_for_template_deployment.name: enabled_for_template_deployment
enabled_for_template_deployment.description: Boolean flag to specify whether Azure Resource Manager is permitted to retrieve secrets from the key vault

enable_rbac_authorization.name: enable_rbac_authorization
enable_rbac_authorization.description: Boolean flag to specify whether Azure Key Vault uses Role Based Access Control (RBAC) for authorization of data actions

purge_protection_enabled.name: purge_protection_enabled
purge_protection_enabled.description: Is Purge Protection enabled for this Key Vault?

soft_delete_retention_days.name: soft_delete_retention_days
soft_delete_retention_days.description: The number of days that items should be retained for once soft-deleted

public_network_access_enabled.name: public_network_access_enabled
public_network_access_enabled.description: Whether public network access is allowed for this Key Vault

tags.name: tags
tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the resource
